review.title: Advisory review
review.emptyBody: No advisories waiting for review for {{date}}. Change the date or run the daily job.
review.subtitle: Advisories drafted by the rules engine for the issue of {{date}}. Nothing reaches farmers until an officer approves it.
review.reviewerHint: Written into the history of every advisory you review. There is no login in the prototype.
review.readOnly: These advisories come from the demo files, which are read-only. To approve or reject, start the API and serve advisories from it (see .env.example).
review.noneBody: No advisories are {{status}} for {{date}}. Change the status filter or the date.
review.pickBody: Choose an advisory in the list, or move with the arrow keys and press Enter.
review.translationPending: Hindi and Punjabi texts are drafts that need review by a native speaker.
review.noTranslation: No text in this language yet. Farmers see the English until one is written.
review.willDrop: The English of this field changed, so this translation will be cleared when you save. Edit it here to keep a translation.
review.needEnglish: English text is needed: it is what farmers see when a translation is missing.
review.noEvidence: The rule gave no evidence rows.
review.evidenceEnglish: Evidence rows are in English (officer view).
review.rejectReason: Reason for rejecting (saved in the history)
review.keys: Keys: arrow keys move through the list, Enter opens, Ctrl+Enter approves.

blocked.readOnly: Reviewing needs the API; the demo files are read-only.
blocked.noReviewer: Enter your name under Reviewing as first.
blocked.hasEdits: You changed the text: choose Save edit and approve, or Undo edits.
blocked.missingEnglish: Fill in the English text of every field before saving.
blocked.alreadyApproved: Already approved. Change the text to save a new version, or reject it.

review.saveFailed: Could not save the review. Check the server is running, then try again.
